celebration_crowd_lines: Toad City! Toad City! Toad City!
Hop it up, hon, we did it!
Best night on the harbor ever!
Ribbit loud so the pier hears you!
That's our Toad, born and raised!
Ring the bells on Federal Hill!
Dance it out on the cobblestones!
We're gonna talk about this forever!
Croak if you love this town!
Party at the rowhouse stoop, hon!
drone_sightseeing_captions: Inner Harbor at golden hour, lily pads and all
Federal Hill, best view of the Toad City skyline
Water taxi gliding past the old brick warehouses
Rowhouse rooftops stretching out like piano keys
Fells Point cobblestones, still shiny after rain
The tall ship docked where it always waits for you
Marble steps scrubbed clean on every single block
Market hall roof, busy since before sunrise
Toad Stadium lights warming up for the big game
Lighthouse at the harbor mouth, blinking hello
Neon sign on the hill, glowing over the harbor
Sunset over the docks, time to hop on home
grand_prix_announcer_lines: Green flag drops on Pratt Street!
Lap two, and the pack is hopping tight!
Final lap! Toad City holds its breath!
Lap five done, pit crews stand ready!
What a pass at the harbor hairpin!
Inside line, slick move, new leader!
Side by side down the waterfront!
Crash at turn three! Everybody's okay!
Spinout into the hay bales, oof!
Checkered flag! We have a winner!
Champion of the Toad City Grand Prix!
credits_lines: Made with love in Toad City
Lead Toad: the whole Toad City crew
Harbor art by the rowhouse crew
Race tuning by the pit lane gang
Crowd voices by every stoop on the block
Water taxi rides courtesy of the harbor
Special thanks to all our playtesters
No toads were harmed in the making
See you back on the harbor soon!
